description: This PHP file is part of an OpenCart admin module, defining a Controller class for managing tax rates, including listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting tax rate data within the localisation subsystem.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD operations for tax rates in the admin localisation module of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the list view, loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and loads the tax rate list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch and display the list of tax rates.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches tax rates data from model, handles pagination, and returns the rendered tax rate list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for adding or editing a tax rate, loading necessary related data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles submission of the tax rate form, validates permissions and data, and updates or creates tax rate records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tax rates after permission checks and validation, returning success or errors.
